_comment: Emeria, the Sky Ruin: the upkeep return is searched at the preceding turn boundary. Six Plains + Emeria + Heliod; hand Plains; graveyard Auriok Champion + Ranger-Captain of Eos; Walking Ballista is the library's only creature. T7 plays the 7th Plains, arming the T8 trigger. The provider front is Auriok Champion, which cannot win; returning Ranger-Captain tutors Ballista and wins on T8. The depth-zero control takes the provider front and does not win.
